g.text: Aggregate surfacing set in the flood coat, (1) and (2)

svg.text: Aggregate used for surfacing built-up roofs is
clean, dry and durable and consists of
particles of gravel, crushed stone or
air-cooled blast furnace slag having a size of
The minimum amount of aggregate surfacing per
square metre of roof surface is 15 kg (307 lb
per 100 ft²) gravel or crushed stone or 10 kg
